summary:
Final Milestone 5 Architecture and Security Specification (Version 8.0 - Definitive).
Resolves all four blocking security defects:
1. Privileged C launcher (/usr/bin/run_nobody with CAP_SETUID/CAP_SETGID) enforcing non-root transition to UID 65534, aborting on any failure (never swallowing errors), with O_CLOEXEC and Linux DAC memory protection.
2. Complete tenant-scoped Redis Cluster Lua state machine ({tenant:<tenantId>}) handling dual-key and single-key modes, monotonic fencing generation keys, durable AMBIGUOUS_LAUNCH records, exponential backoff, and full collision/replay resolution.
3. Completely non-blocking raw selector pipe protocol (deadline started before process creation and stdin write, strict 64KB stdout limit, 16KB circular stderr buffer, single UTF-8 line enforcement, extra output rejection).
4. Cloud Run v2 API launch reconciliation with durable AMBIGUOUS_LAUNCH quarantine (preventing blind duplicate launches), GCS generation preconditions (x-goog-if-generation-match: 0), zero-permission executor SA, and Direct VPC egress.
5. Strict claim discipline throughout, expanded 22-vector adversarial test matrix, and final implementation readiness decision.
